brief_title: Study of Chiglitazar Compare With Sitagliptin in Type 2 Diabetes Patients
official_title: Phase III Study of Chiglitazar in Patients With Type 2 Diabetes Mellitus and Insufficient Glycemic Control Despite Diet and Exercise -- A Multicenter, Randomized, Double-Blind, and Sitagliptin-Controlled Trial

primary_outcomes.measure: Change in HbA1c from baseline after 24 weeks of treatment

brief_summary: The purpose of this study is to evaluate the efficacy and safety of Chiglitazar, compare with Sitagliptin.
